recording.value: Territorial EU public-domain basis: Columbia L 1798 was published no later than 3 March 1928
recording.note: Rule 3. The Wanganui Chronicle’s dated review names L 1798, Mengelberg, the Concertgebouw Orchestra and the Adagietto, establishing publication independently of the May 1926 session. The exact first-release date remains unknown; source.rights.published 1928 is a documented upper bound. The recording’s 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. US status is not established. The selected item’s complete metadata, original-FLAC provenance and disc images disclose no Creative Commons non-commercial licence or separate upstream digital source. No licence is inferred from Mahler’s composition rights.
